profile.headline: Software Engineer • MacOS/iOS Development • Networking Protocols • IPv4/IPv6 • Security/Firewalls • Cloud-based Infrastructure (client)
profile.summary:
I’m Eric Kampman, a software engineer in MacOS/iOS development and networking hardware/firmware. Colleagues claim that I’m a “creative thinker” whose work is “always well thought out, user-friendly and solid,” reflecting my “strong drive to create quality products.” (See Recommendations, below.) They also say I play well with others and have a sense of humor. I’m not going to argue.

More about me: 

• Experienced in a wide variety of development environments and targets, including Xcode and Broadcom BSP.

• Innovative problem-solving skills grounded in knowledge of multiple programming languages as well as tenacity and creativity. 

• In-depth expertise in all phases of the product life cycle, with massive product volumes and aggressive deadlines. 

• Extensive collaboration with Marketing, Quality Assurance, User Documentation, Manufacturing and Tech Support. Experience in coaching and mentoring engineers. 

SKILLS:
Languages: C, Python, Swift, Objective C, HTML / XML, C++
Development Tools: XCode, Git, GNU, BBEdit
Operating Systems: Linux (uClinux, Ubuntu, Fedora, Gentoo), OS X, ThreadX
Web Servers: Apache
Traffic Tools: Wireshark, scapy, nmap, hping3

SPECIALTIES:

SwiftUI, Appkit
Firewalls / iptables / ip6tables / netfilter
TCP/IP: HTTP, NAT, DNS, DHCP
Device / service security risk identification and resolution
802.1x Supplicant / EAP-TLS
Per-device X.509 certificates 
Software optimization

INTERESTS:

Swift and Objective-C audio and MIDI programming. Independent studies in math and technology.

Networking with other professionals is a good thing, therefore I add: ericlkampman(at)gmail(dot)com

positions.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop MacOS networking and security software.

•	Primary engineer responsible for implementation, improvement, and maintenance of Networking Socket Filter System Extension, installation and uninstallation via VMWare InstallBuilder, MDM, high-profile customer support, and documentation review/editing. 
•	Designed and Implemented Antivirus Posture Verification, which examines system for active, running Endpoint Security System Extensions.
•	Designed and implemented OS Posture Verification, which checks current OS version against required minimum versions.
•	Support Federal customer Jira escalations on Apple products.
positions.insights: Skills: Swift (Programming Language) · Application Development · Networking · C (Programming Language)

positions.title: Principal Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and delivered a wide range of enhancements for router-embedded software.

Linux-based Networking Client Software
•	Integrated MoCA Driver upgrade and performed MoCA troubleshooting. MaxLinear MoCA driver included B+ Profile support, which allows for improved compatibility with third-party devices. 
•	Developed IPv6 backup enhancements and contributed to implementation of RFC7278 support, which allowed WAN interface IPv6 address to be within subnet assigned on LAN, providing more efficient distribution of IPv6 addressing on LTE networks. 
•	Architected and implemented TR-69 TR-181 Device.InterfaceStack. Completed stacked representation of the device (router, bridge, interface stack), an important data model for our customers. 
•	Owned 802.1x troubleshooting and bug fixes. Resolved IPC communication issues for key customer with retries and longer timeouts.

positions.title: Independent Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed several applications/plugins for MIDI and audio processing and for fractal image generation.

•	Designed macOS/iOS synth and effects audio units written in Objective-C, Objective-C++ and Swift (AUv3). Currently in beta test via Test Flight. Includes custom user interface (UI) controls with tailored light and dark modes.
•	Developed additive synthesis audio unit and compression plugin (AudioUnit version 2).
•	Created MIDI arpeggiator/soft keyboard in Swift.
•	Released Fractus IFS fractal software via Dynamic Software; later rewrote this entirely in Swift.  
•	Contributing author of Exploring Fractals on the Macintosh, published by Addison-Wesley.
positions.insights: Skills: User Interface Design · Application Development · C (Programming Language)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed enhancements and maintained client side of Kyocera’s cloud-based device management system.

Linux-based Networking Client Software:
• Designed and delivered TLS Certificate Enhancements for Cloud Management - Added TLS server certificate examination and qualification for Kyocera’s cloud management software.
• Designed and delivered auditlog/syslog daemon for SIEM integration, substantially reducing development and support costs. 
• Owned client side of Cloud-based printer management service. This makes extensive use of libcurl, and includes HTTP, HTTPS, XMPP and BOSH protocols.
• Brought up new build server and development environment on CenOS 7.3.
• Coached and mentored junior engineers.

company.name: KYOCERA Document Solutions Development America, Inc.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer / Principal Staff Engineer
positions.description:
Developed, integrated and tested networking, authentication, and secure communications applications. Supervised engineering team in manager's absence; advised team members on design and implementation. Collaborated cross-functionally with Quality Assurance, User Documentation and Product Management. 

Linux CPE:
• Recognized with Eighth Amendment Award and bonus for debugging critical defect that had obstructed release and necessitated daily meetings with key client.
• Designed and delivered "conntrack cap" netfilter module for large global telecom. Consisting of userland and kernel components, feature prevents loss of high-priority traffic under extreme conditions. 
• Added IPv6 support to Linux RTSP ALG.
• Owned architecture to maintain consistent iptables / ip6tables rules across multiple client applications. Ensured proper router functionality and NAT coexist with firewall protections against threats including floods / DoS attacks.
• Developed and owned Mocana-based 802.1x supplicant using EAP-TLS authentication.

DSL/Ethernet CPE – Platforms: ThreadX / Epilogue
• Wrote security protection for critical DNS Kaminsky attack as well as XSS (Cross-Site Scripting and CSRF (Cross-Site Request Forgery) web server security vulnerability fixes for multiple hardware and software platforms. Met security requirements for multiple large volume customers. 
• Integrated and owned Mocana SSL/802.1x/EAP and implemented support for proprietary PKI infrastructure. Defined requirements to PKI Services division and wrote / modified support tools for Manufacturing. Wrote support tools in Python. 
• Coordinated cross-department efforts among Product Marketing, Manufacturing, Quality Assurance and Customer Feedback for the 802.1x/certificate deployment project.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Netopia became a division of Motorola in 2007.

DSL / Ethernet CPE - Platforms: ThreadX / Epilogue
•	Developed architecture for flexible DHCP server and client options configuration and negotiation, and implemented related RTSP ALG used for triple-play customers in Europe. 
•	Ported open-source FTP server code, OFTPD, to ThreadX/Epilogue TCP stack environment to support downloading firmware and configuration downloads for high-profile European customer.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Consultant)
positions.description:
Cross-Platform Secure Software Source Code Development - Platforms: Embedded, OS X, Windows, Unix
•	Implemented SSH client, licensed to Mocana customers as source code, for existing SSH server implementation. Sole engineer responsible for RADIUS client source code. Achieved all goals for portability, code size, consistency with existing source code, and ease of use. 
•	Revamped memory utilization model in big integer math library for substantial heap utilization and performance gains.
positions.insights: Skills: Application Development · Networking · C (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Parental Controls Project - Platforms: vxWorks, Cisco WRT54GS	
Responsible for HTTP proxy, configuration heartbeat protocol design and implementation (client and server), numerous features and enhancements.  Integral member of team that migrated BSD parental controls code to VxWorks and Linux, leading to new contract with Cisco / Linksys as the sole source of parental controls code in source form, on their popular WRT54GS CPE. 

•	Achieved 10-fold improvement in request handling by Java servlet by implementing direct SQL calls, optimizing loops and minimizing exceptions for normal program flow. 
•	Implemented Parental controls status "tray-app" in Java to make application available to all major PC operating systems. 

WAN (ISDN/DSL) Router - Platforms: ThreadX, Vertex, Mac application	
Principal user interface engineer for Farallon’s / Netopia's edge router products, including web, command-line, back-end and menu-based VT100 user interfaces. Designed configuration and status UI for TCP/IP, AppleTalk, PPP/MP and others. Also frequently worked with TCP and UDP embedded applications, e.g. DNS proxy, HTTP proxy, and TFTP clients. Spearheaded development of web user interface for router products. Ported embedded web servers and designed and implemented configuration and status web pages.

•	Implemented many facets of ease-of-configuring Internet connectivity project; designed Macintosh configuration wizard and embedded DNS proxy, and contributed to other innovations. 
•	Pioneered standardization of LAN and DHCP configuration with NAT, substantially reducing technical support calls. 

Macintosh Software - Platforms: Macintosh

•	Developed and maintained network management and forwarding software.

patents.title: Printing system and device for processing transactions in a distributed ledger
patents.description: Abstract: A printing system for processing entries in a distributed ledger manages documents or transactions based on printing or scanning operations. A computing platform within the system receives a first entry having a variable set of data. The computing platform determines a partial chain hash of the first entry using the variable set of data. The computing platform generates at least one additional entry having at least one additional variable set of data. The computing platform updates the partial chain hash with the at least one additional variable set of data of the at least one additional entry. The computing platform generates a block having a block header for a blockchain using the partial chain hash when a condition is met. The block includes transactions or documents to be printed at a printing device using the distributed ledger.
